Overview

Subotica is a city in Vojvodina with a population of 97,000. A city in northern Vojvodina near the Hungarian border, known for its stunning Art Nouveau architecture and the nearby Palić Lake. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
